_source: Merchant Gear (42 double-sided cards, codes 13A0476–13A0517): side = normal, reforged = Reforged Merchant Gear side. Price = buy, reforgePrice = cost to flip (Outpost). Die shades: red / dark=black / light=white.
notes: Reforged sides carry no card code (top-right strip is blank), so reforgedCode is null.
Power/armor die colours: red = red-filled die; white = light-filled die; black = dark-filled die with white outline (matches the black armor dice on Light Lamellar / Kite Shield / Pavise).
bonusPower: {raw:N} = '+N [sword]'; {dice:[colour]} = '+ [die icon]'; both when both are printed.

Text tokens: [Heat] blue H cost, [Exhaust] card-with-arrow, [Power] sword icon, [Two-handed] double-gauntlet gate tag (gate name TWO-HANDED), [Star] unidentified token icon (see unclear), [GRAVE]/[MAJOR]/[JUDICIUM] red peril tags (also listed in gates).
squireTriggers: 아이콘(redX/book/greenCircle/blueTriangle) 보너스 줄 = 스콰이어 처리용 — Rogue's Path에서 무시 (사용자 확인 2026-11-02); power = sword, potential = goblet.
evasion = '+N' with helmet-and-swoosh icon in the right column; evasionReroll used only for Scale Mail's circle-and-arrow icon (see its unclear entry).
hands: 0 for armor (breastplate slot). Shields use the single-gauntlet slot, so type weapon / hands 1.
Kingdom Gear Merchant 덱은 Principality와 동일 — Sunken 등 다른 왕국 Outpost도 이 덱 사용 (사용자 확인 2026-11-03)
